page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations position the ecs.r7.8xlarge consistently in the average performance tier across most compute and memory workloads. The single-core stress-ng CPU performance score is 1865.39, while the multi-core score reaches 30983.52. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 1689.81 GB/sec, dropping to 141.73 GB/sec for large uncached blocks, and a write speed of 65.94 GB/sec. In database operations, the instance achieves a PassMark database score of 13455.54 and processes 30.13 million Redis SET operations per second.

For language model tasks, the instance demonstrates strong performance in text generation with a small 135M model, reaching 282.15 tokens per second, though prompt processing for the same model remains in the average tier at 2011.18 tokens per second. Medium 7B model inference yields average speeds of 58.78 tokens per second for prompts and 17.54 tokens per second for text generation. The lack of local storage and GPU acceleration represents a clear tradeoff, making this instance less suitable for heavy graphics processing or local high-speed disk caching, but highly efficient for memory-intensive, network-reliant workloads such as relational databases, in-memory caching, and enterprise applications.
